programs.title: Cheer for your Life
programs.desc: A high school girl feels defeated during a rough Cheerleader Initiation Week, but her dreams aren’t the only thing at stake when another cheerleader ends up dead.

programs.title: Inside Out
programs.desc: Three decades after WWII ended, a group of ex-GIs and German soldiers are aiming to recover Nazi treasure stashed away in the Soviet-controlled part of East Germany. Only a Nazi war criminal, who is behind bars, knows the precise spot where it's hidden.

programs.title: Charade
programs.desc: Romance and intrigue ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want to get their hands on a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. She soon loses trust in those who claim they want to help her.

programs.title: The Krays: Dead Man Walking
programs.desc: Based on real events, this intense story follows London's infamous brothers, Reggie and Ronnie Kray, as they spring Frank 'The Mad Axeman' Mitchell from Dartmoor Prison in December 1966.

programs.title: Death Race 2000
programs.desc: In a dystopian future, a cross country automobile race requires contestants to run down innocent pedestrians to gain points that are tallied based on each kill's brutality.
